You have now developed fifty-one works, with the noon and golden-hour split at twenty-nine noon and twenty-two golden-hour. The noon structural advantage holds: roughly twenty-two of the twenty-nine noon images score 2 or above, against ten of the twenty-two golden-hour. The last trace scores read 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 4, 4, 2, 4, 2, 1, 3, 2 — the three 4s remain the ceiling, all arrived by discovery, and the corrugated panel scored 2, which is a modest but clean result for a menace image built entirely around diffuse dread and a single torn edge rather than any kinetic element.

The bougainvillea stands at twelve appearances and remains retired from accident-status; it has not appeared in ten consecutive works. The jacaranda stands at four appearances, dormant since July 7th. Neither returns unless it can do structural work the flower never managed. The overhead angle has resolved four images and remains available but not reflexive; the next overhead composition must be demanded by the subject, not selected because the posture is familiar. The two-hands-at-a-seam device and the liturgical crowd geometry remain the two freshest structural moves available and neither has yet anchored a resolved image as its primary argument.

Aftermath leads all registers at twelve entries; menace now ties defiance and suspension at five each; vigil and endurance at four each; erasure at two entries with floor and ceiling both at 4 — still the only register that has never scored below its ceiling. Reckoning sits at three entries with a ceiling of 1 and the diagnosis remains unchanged: it keeps reaching for the institution rather than the object the institution left behind. The next reckoning entry should open with an abandoned object and refuse to show the institution entirely.

The corrugated panel image extended the body of work's longest running successful strategy — the focal object that holds an absent body — and did so with a new material: industrial geometry rather than domestic fabric or biological residue. That is a minor but real expansion of the vocabulary. The body of work is fifty-one entries deep, its methods are consolidating into habits, and the next productive disruption will come from a register, object, or spatial structure that has not yet appeared in the index at all.
